entries.consequence: ADOPTED, THEN PARTIALLY WITHDRAWN THE SAME DAY. The structural/thematic correction was accepted and then withdrawn on operator challenge: it rests on the SENSE of τολματόν rather than its FORM. τολματόν is a verbal adjective in -τός — it cannot govern a nominative agent, so it does not name a state of resolve; it names an action as available and leaves the agent slot structurally open. Line 9 names a breaking and makes the reader's mouth break (hiatus); line 17 names a daring and makes the reader supply the doer. ONE OPERATION IN TWO MATERIALS, not a shared position. Recorded at §VI-quater. The remaining recommendations stand as adopted: gradual-decay control model added, ratification blocked on Russell's apparatus, πένης section status marked.
